history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the United Nations Treasury formalize the participation of different entities in the main cash pool by way of written agreements with them.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. The Administration has established template documentation for the provision of investment management services, which is prepared by the Office of Legal Affairs and has been attached to the related memorandum issued by the General Legal Division. The Administration also identified the entities for which such documentation may be used, as appropriate.
history.board_assessment: Given that the template documentation for memorandums of understanding and investment management agreements has been established, and the entities for which such documentation may be used have been identified, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
